purpose: A chip that shows the open vault and, on a tap, lists the vaults the person reaches, own first and shared ones labelled, and hands back the one they pick.

library.title: Vault switcher (a chip with the open vault and a sheet to pick another)
library.note: A chip with the open vault's name; a tap opens a sheet listing the vaults the person reaches, own first, shared and view-only ones labelled, the open one marked, and calls onPick with the chosen vault. React, on modal-sheet and vault-list (vaultChoices, choiceLine). It lists with the load you pass; the list itself is reachable-vaults or signin's listVaults. Also found as: vault chooser; choose a vault; pick another vault; switch between shared vaults.
